subject: Metric alignment & cost closure plan for HelixMed MAP
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@helixmed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 15 Jan 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Metric alignment & cost closure plan for HelixMed MAP

Samantha — attaching an updated MAP workbook (helixmed_map_v3.xlsx) and the token-econ simulation (token-econ-sim.csv). High level ask: before we lock the MAP milestones I want alignment on the unit econ assumptions so procurement has what it needs for the PO. Key assumptions in sheet "Econ-summary":

- Base tokens per call: 450 tokens (avg chat + system prompts).
- Tokens/$ used for hosted baseline: $0.0025 per token equivalent (this is our current quoted hosted rate for the LLM profile we discussed).
- Caching: we modeled prefix/KV cache hit = 28% in pilot (conservative); please flag if you expect higher reuse.
- Batching: default production batch target = 8 requests (reduces per-token infra by ~22% in sim), but we simulated smaller batch = 4 for low-latency paths.
- Canary plan: pilot traffic 10k calls/day (approx 4.5M tokens/day); we included a dedicated pool cost for the pilot window and a fallback to hosted if sustained traffic < 50% of forecast.

Questions for your team to confirm: monthly token projection (we used 5M to 20M scenarios in the sheet), acceptable P95 latency threshold for the NLU path, and whether you can tolerate ~50–100ms extra tail for batching benefits.

Next steps: if you confirm the token projection and cache expectations by EOD Friday I’ll update the MAP milestones to include the procurement target dates and the DocuSign link for the SOW.

Attachments: helixmed_map_v3.xlsx (MAP worksheets), token-econ-sim.csv (scenario outputs)

—Markus
Markus Klein

From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@helixmed.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@helixmed.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jan 2029 11:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Metric alignment & cost closure plan for HelixMed MAP

Thanks Markus — reviewed quickly and a few clarifying points so procurement can triage the numbers: 

1) On caching: our team expects higher local reuse for templated responses (closer to 40–45%) because many patient-facing replies are templated. Can you re-run the sim with a 40% hit?
2) On batching: our product team is nervous about increased per-call latency. Their target P95 is < 350ms for the NLU path. Can you show the latency uplift for batch sizes 4 and 8 versus single-request?
3) Procurement asked for an example PO timeline — our internal procurement window is ~4 weeks once we have SOW + pricing.

Also — for pilot success metrics we want: availability >= 99.5%, token-cost variance <= 15% vs model, and an integration checklist for KV encryption.

Happy to jump on a short call Thursday morning (10–10:30am ET) to go over the sim outputs.

—Samantha Ruiz
VP Product, HelixMed
samantha@helixmed.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2029 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Metric alignment & cost closure plan for HelixMed MAP (internal)

Markus / Karthik — quick thoughts after a first pass on Samantha's asks:

- Re-run sims with cache hit = 40% (HelixMed expectation). That decreases billable tokens ~12–14% in our model; I'll update token-econ-sim.csv and add a delta sheet.
- Latency vs batching: single-request P95 baseline = ~310ms on hosted. Batch=4 adds ~45–65ms depending on concurrency, batch=8 adds ~85–120ms but reduces infra cost per token by ~20–24% (numbers in the sim). If they require <350ms P95 we can support batch=4 for the NLU path and batch=8 for async/low-latency-tolerant routes.
- Pricing recommendation: propose a pilot blended rate that factors in expected caching (so effective tokens/$ increases). Suggest quote line: "hosted rate $0.0025/token; pilot effective rate $0.0021/token reflecting 40% cache; dedicated pool discount may apply after month 2 at commit levels."

Action items I can take: run the 40% cache scenario and export a one-page slide of the tradeoffs (latency vs tokens/$). Karthik — can you confirm whether we should model a dedicated-pool amortization cost for the 30-day pilot (approx additional $6k) or treat it as optional?

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@helixmed.com>, procurement@helixmed.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 25 Jan 2029 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Metric alignment & cost closure plan for HelixMed MAP

Samantha / HelixMed procurement — thanks for the quick feedback. We updated the MAP workbook and the sim per Ben's notes; highlights below and next actions to close the MAP and procurement timeline:

- Updated assumptions: cache hit = 40%, batch strategy = hybrid (batch=4 for NLU P95-critical routes, batch=8 for lower-latency-sensitive workloads). Updated effective token cost for pilot = $0.00208/token (sheet: "Econ-summary -> Pilot-blended").
- Latency: modeled P95 with batch=4 = ~355ms (including network), batch=8 = ~410ms. We will instrument an opt-out per-route knob so HelixMed can enforce single-request paths for critical flows during pilot.
- Pilot amortization: suggested dedicated pool reserve for the 30-day pilot = $6,250 (optional). If procurement prefers no upfront reserve we will run on hosted with automatic fallbacks; pricing will be the blended pilot rate above and total spend tracked in the MAP.

MAP milestone & close timeline (proposed):
- 2029-01-26: sign SOW (DocuSign link sent after you confirm PO owner).
- 2029-02-02 to 2029-02-16: pilot window (30 days rough), instrumentation + latency tuning week 1.
- 2029-02-20: pilot review + cost/eval checkpoint (RevOps + Product + SRE).
- 2029-03-01: target decision (move to dedicated vs hosted).

DocuSign / SOW: https://app.docusign.com/abcdef (will populate once you confirm PO owner).
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HLX-2029-042

Please confirm PO owner and whether you want the dedicated reserve included in the SOW. If you want, I can open a 30-min technical deep-dive during pilot week 1 to fine-tune batching knobs.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

—Markus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
